name: Free-Slip Boundary Condition Enforcement
aliases: Dynamic Obstacle Handling with Free-Slip Boundary
definition: A scheme for handling dynamic obstacles using inside-outside voxelization and a voxelized representation of obstacle velocity, enforcing a free-slip boundary condition where fluid velocity normal to the boundary equals solid velocity normal to the boundary.
summary: Free-Slip Boundary Condition Enforcement ensures fluid velocity normal to dynamic voxelized obstacles matches the solid's normal velocity while retaining tangential slip, distinguishing it from no-slip conditions by preserving tangential fluid velocity.
